content:
emily: quick design drop  prototype for a token-cost exposure heatmap. rows = model_sku, cols = tenant buckets. cells show unit cost, cache-savings credited, and an info icon that toggles 'allocation view' (amortized vs marginal). figma: https://figma.redwood.local/token-heatmap (WIP)

rob: looks useful. couple of questions: 1) how do we define 'credited' cache savings? 2) data staleness expectations?

tarek: for 1) we should separate direct-owner credits (first-writer of prefix) from shared-prefetch credits. my vote: attribute direct hits to owner route, split prefetch credits pro-rata across sessions based on session token weight. that'll be deterministic and explainable.

zheng: important infra note: emitting per-invocation float fractions will explode cardinality. please quantize. also prefer emitting a tiny enum for `cache_credit_bucket` rather than free float.

emily: good call. proposal for producer SDK (pseudo):
```
emitInvocation({
  id: "inv-...",
  model: "redwood-7b-q",
  tokens_in: 120,
  tokens_out: 40,
  cache_credit_enum: "0.0|0.01|0.05|0.1|0.25|0.5|1",
  credit_type: "direct|shared"
})
```
heatmap reads daily rollups: (tenant, model, variant, day) -> tokens, cache_hits, apportioned_token_credit_bucket_counts

rob: SGTM. can we compute rollups at hourly granularity for the console preview? daily is fine for billing but ops wants faster feedback during rollouts.

tarek: we can do hourly derived stream with coarser aggregation. run rollup job per-shard, group-by keys (tenant, model, variant, hour). store in time-series db for the UI.

zheng: ops constraints: 1) keep raw invocation sampling at 0.5-1% for traceability, 2) emit only enums on raw events, 3) run rollups idempotent and backfill-friendly. also add `ingest.schema=v2` header on events so we can gate processing.

ops-bot: snapshot: model=redwood-7b-q hour=2026-03-22T03 cache_hits=23,412 tokens=1,234,123 apportioned_credit_bucket=0.1 counts=12,345

billing-bot: estimate: tenant=acme day=2026-03-22 apportioned_savings=$1,832.11 (from heatmap rollup) :money_with_wings:

emily: UX question: where to surface the allocation explanation? inline popover or a deeper 'Why this number' modal? ui-bot any suggestions?

ui-bot: inline popover for quick explainability, link to modal for full provenance (links to invocation samples + rollup logic). show a tiny sparklines row for 'saved tokens' over last 7 days. also add a copyable CSV export.

rob: rollout plan idea: behind org feature-flag named `token-econ-heatmap`. enable for 10% orgs, monitor `heatmap.query.p95` and `telemetry.rollup.lag`. abort if ingest > +15% or queries > 300ms p95.

tarek: add migration notes for private deployments: they must opt into `ingest.schema=v2` and run the rollup job (we'll ship a k8s job template). include a backfill helper to generate last-30d aggregates.

zheng: also impose cardinality guardrail: reject producer events that have unknown model SKUs > 100k/day and fallback to `model=other`. prevents noisy customers from spiking cardinality.

emily: owners: sam will do producer SDK bump + docs, rob owns console panels/alert, tarek owns rollup infra and k8s job, zheng owns cardinality and ingest gating. I'll own the feature-flag and UX polish.

ops-bot: checklist created: [limit rollup concurrency] [backfill job ready] [hourly derived stream] [alerts: rollup_lag > 2h, query_p95 > 300ms]

billing-bot: small sample delta: tenant=acme model=redwood-7b-q day=2026-03-21 raw_cost=$12,322 apportioned_savings=$1,832 net=$10,490

emily: plan to open PRs: 1) telemetry producer change w/ quantized enum 2) rollup job + backfill 3) console heatmap UI behind flag. target: land producer PR next Wed, start 10% rollout Thurs. objections?

rob: none. will add the Grafana panel and an alert runbook.

tarek: no objections. will add migration doc to the repo for private cluster customers.

emily: thanks all  we'll sync in the eng-platform weekly to confirm metrics after the 10% rollout.
